user.title: Add Pixie home
user.description: Choose how this Pixie installation is controlled.

gateway.title: Pixie Plus with gateway
gateway.description: Use your Pixie account once to choose a home and retrieve the parameters needed for ongoing local operation.

ble_only.title: Pixie without gateway
ble_only.description: Add a Pixie Bluetooth-only installation. This requires an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy device already added to Home Assistant.

ble_only_create_modes.title: Choose device mode
ble_only_create_modes.description: Choose the required setup mode for the selected Pixie device.

home.title: Choose Pixie home
home.description: Choose which Pixie home to add to Home Assistant{finish_text}.

inventory_fallback_notice.title: Pixie credentials will be saved
inventory_fallback_notice.description: This home will use cloud inventory because {reason}. Your Pixie username and password will be stored for this home so the integration can refresh the device list after restarts. Device control and live updates still use the local gateway connection.

gateway_ip.title: Enter gateway IP
gateway_ip.description: Auto-discovery did not find a Pixie gateway within 10 seconds. Enter the gateway IPv4 address to continue.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth support
bluetooth.description: Enable the optional Pixie Bluetooth pathway for {home_name}. This requires an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy device already added to Home Assistant. If no working proxy is found, setup will continue using TCP only.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Pixie entry
reconfigure.description: Choose what you want to update for this Pixie integration.

reconfigure_inventory_mode.title: Try local inventory
reconfigure_inventory_mode.description: Try switching this Pixie home back to direct local inventory over the gateway. If this succeeds, stored Pixie credentials will be removed from the entry.

reconfigure_bluetooth.title: Bluetooth support
reconfigure_bluetooth.description: Enable or disable the optional Pixie Bluetooth pathway. Bluetooth requires an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy device already added to Home Assistant.

reconfigure_credentials.title: Add Pixie credentials
reconfigure_credentials.description: Direct local inventory is unavailable. Enter your Pixie account credentials so the integration can use cloud fallback when needed.

reconfigure_gateway_connection.title: Gateway connection
reconfigure_gateway_connection.description: Choose whether this entry should discover the gateway automatically over UDP or use a stored manual IP address.

reconfigure_gateway_ip.title: Manual gateway IP
reconfigure_gateway_ip.description: Enter the Pixie gateway IPv4 address to store in this config entry.

cover_mapping.title: Blind mapping
cover_mapping.description: Map Home Assistant blind actions to the button positions configured in the Pixie app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Pixie gateway.
error.ble_only_cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Pixie Bluetooth-only installation. Make sure an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy is available and the PIN is correct.
error.bt_proxy_unavailable: No working ESPHome Bluetooth proxy was found. Disable Bluetooth support to continue using TCP only.

abort.already_configured: This Pixie home is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_failed: The Pixie entry could not be reconfigured.

missing_fallback_credentials.title: Pixie credentials required for fallback
missing_fallback_credentials.description: Direct local inventory is unavailable for {entry_title}. The integration is running from the stored inventory snapshot. Reconfigure the integration and enter your Pixie username and password so it can use cloud fallback when direct local inventory is unavailable.

gateway_ip_required.title: Pixie gateway connection requires attention
gateway_ip_required.description: The integration could not reach the Pixie gateway for {entry_title}. Reconfigure the integration to enter a working gateway IP address or switch back to UDP discovery.

bt_proxy_unavailable.title: Pixie Bluetooth proxy unavailable
bt_proxy_unavailable.description: Bluetooth support was requested for {entry_title}, but the integration could not find a working ESPHome Bluetooth proxy. Error: {error}

local_inventory_fallback.title: Pixie local inventory unavailable
local_inventory_fallback.description: {entry_title} is using cloud inventory because {reason}. Device control and live updates still use the local gateway connection. You can try local inventory again from the integration reconfigure menu.

init.title: Pixie options
init.description: Choose which Pixie option to change.

ha_name_sync.title: Device name sync
ha_name_sync.description: Choose whether Home Assistant device name changes should also rename the device in the Pixie app. Entity name changes are not synced.

data.sync_ha_device_names: Sync HA device name changes to Pixie

update_device_versions.title: Update device versions
update_device_versions.description: Scan briefly for Pixie Bluetooth advertisements and update device firmware versions when the devices report a newer value.

add_device_modes.title: Choose device mode
add_device_modes.description: Choose the required setup mode for the selected Pixie device.

transport.title: Bluetooth settings
transport.description: Choose Bluetooth command behavior and access-node preference.

cover_controller.title: Blind mapping
cover_controller.description: Adjust the button positions used for blind commands.

abort.no_blind_devices: No blind devices were found for this Pixie home.
